name: Front lever
description: A horizontal hold under a bar, face up, with straight arms and a straight body. It is built by lengthening the lever one step at a time.

steps.label: Scapular pulls
steps.cue: Pull your shoulder blades down without bending your arms.

steps.label: Tuck front lever
steps.cue: Keep your arms locked and your hips level with your shoulders.

steps.label: Advanced tuck front lever
steps.cue: Flatten your back; go back a step if your lower back arches.

steps.label: One leg front lever
steps.cue: Switch the straight leg each set and keep your hips from dropping.

steps.label: Straddle front lever
steps.cue: Open the legs wide and squeeze your glutes to stay flat.

steps.label: Full front lever
steps.cue: Legs together, body in one straight line.
